protocol.purpose: LR tuning and independent-seed confirmation of token-conditioned CIFAR-10 ViT
protocol.artifact_retention: retain source/configs, seeds, split indices, logs, metrics, selection, audit and summaries until explicitly removed
protocol.selection_metric: final validation accuracy at epoch 20; tie break by lower matmul FLOPs then lower LR
protocol.exact_confirmation_rule: include only if best tuning endpoint is within 1 percentage point of the best tuned plain endpoint
protocol.controls: plain width 216 approximates diagonal/static-LoRA parameter budget; width 240 exceeds DPLR's budget slightly; report actual parameters and FLOPs
protocol.selection_limit: one fixed held-out validation split; confirmation seeds are independent of tuning seed; no official test or significance claim

selection.selection_metric: final validation accuracy at epoch 20; tie break by lower matmul FLOPs then lower LR

tuning.selection_limit: tuning/confirmation uses a held-out training split; official test is not evaluated

confirmation.selection_limit: tuning/confirmation uses a held-out training split; official test is not evaluated

uncertainty: sample SD over three initialization/data-order seeds; not a confidence interval or test-set estimate
